mapper.select: SELECT A.recipeseq, A.r_subject, A.r_imgname, A.fk_userseq, B.nickname, B.profile_sysfilename, A.r_views, NVL(C.avg_rating, 0) AS avg_rating, A.paid_check FROM tbl_recipe A JOIN tbl_member B ON A.fk_userseq = B.userseq LEFT JOIN ( SELECT fk_recipesesq, ROUND(AVG(review_rating), 1) AS avg_rating, -- 소수점 첫째 자리까지 반올림 (예: 4.5) COUNT(*) AS review_count FROM tbl_recipe_review GROUP BY fk_recipesesq ) C ON A.recipeseq = C.fk_recipesesq
